### Executive Summary
A data breach involving a North Carolina-based medical supply company has affected more than 44,000 residents of South Carolina. The incident was reported by media outlet WLTX.

Further operational details regarding the identity of the medical supply organization and the full timeline of the compromise have not yet been confirmed in the available reporting.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The technical root cause, initial access vector, and specific compromised systems associated with the breach are currently unknown. 

The confirmed technical impact is limited to the exposure of data belonging to over 44,000 individuals in South Carolina. Additional information regarding the specific types of sensitive or personal data exposed has not yet been confirmed.

Specific remediation steps and mitigations have not been provided in the source material. Affected entities typically advise impacted individuals to monitor financial accounts and credit reports for suspicious activity following a healthcare or medical supply data breach.
